text:
leah_cs: Quick capture from onboarding w/ FinnRetail. Account health green but renewal flagged because of two feature asks + a couple onboarding pain points. Pasting notes to triage.

max_pm: thanks. drop the raw asks here and i'll triage prioritization.

leah_cs: cleaned notes:
- Feature 1: per-route/model cost breakdown in Console + CSV export. (renewal concern = medium)
- Feature 2: webhook + canary hook for model rollouts so their QA can validate before traffic cutover. (renewal concern = high)
- Pain A: onboarding docs for VPC peering are sparse; they got stuck on subnet hints.
- Pain B: billing email line-items ambiguous — embeddings vs generation tokens. Finance pinged us.

rita_enable: i can assemble a VPC peering checklist and a short subnet example today. will include known gotchas for dedicated.

jordan_prod: Feature 2 is time-sensitive. omar, can engineering stand up a demo webhook relay for them to validate?

omar_eng: yes. we can build an authenticated relay + replay hook. estimate 3 business days for a safe demo. also can add a temporary CSV export for Feature 1 in ~4 days as a stopgap.

max_pm: proposed plan: 1) RW-4601 (Feature 2) -> P0, assigned to omar. 2) RW-4602 (Feature 1) -> P1 for console work + quick CSV task. 3) RW-4603 (onboarding docs) -> P2 -> rita. 4) leah to collect billing screenshots for Pain B.

leah_cs: added screenshots here https://files.redwood/finnretail/billing-sample.png and assigned tickets. flagged RW-4601 as customer-blocking on renewal tracker.

redwood-bot: Created Jira issues RW-4601, RW-4602, RW-4603.

jordan_prod: suggestion  for faster unblock: provide a signed webhook signing secret and a small guidance doc so their QA can start signing requests locally.

omar_eng: will include signing doc in demo package.

max_pm: thanks all. rita please post the VPC checklist draft back here when ready; leah keep renewal team updated if customer pushes escalation.

leah_cs: will do. i'll also post a 1-pager summary to the renewal channel and follow up with FinnRetail's renewal manager.
